title: Chocolates
description: this mod adds a ton of chocolate!
body:
this mod adds a lot of chocolates!

dark chooclate:gives you strength for 30 seconds

milk chocolate:gives you speed for 30 seconds

white chocolate:gives you regeneration for 30 seconds

ruby chocolate:gives you abosrption for 30 seconds

supreme dark chocolate:gives you strength III for 60 seconds

dubai chocolate:gives you resistance and speed for 30 seconds

golden chocolate gives you regeneration,fire resistance,resistance,haste,and absorption 30 seconds

mint chocolate:gives you fire resistance cause you're cool 30 seconds

orange zest chocolate:gives you night vision for 30 seconds
